text:
leo: Short notice  embeddings-service spikes 5xx after last quant-opt rollout. Need hotpatch in this late window (starts in ~18m). Proposing v2.3.1-hotfix.
deploybot: Canary preflight queued for embeddings-service@v2.3.1-hotfix. Canary target: 2 nodes (low traffic). Running checks: /health, error-rate(1m), tokenizer-smoke. ETA 7m.
ana: I'll prep the small synthetic set and monitor customer lanes. posting results when canary is up.
ops-oncall-bot: Noted. Paging policy: page if error-rate > 1.0% sustained for 3m. PD rotation: ana (primary), rory (backup). Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/embeds-hotfix-latewindow
deploybot: Canary live. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1749998881/canary
ana: smoke run started: 12 prompts across short and long inputs.
leo: quick rollback plan: if errors spike >0.9% for 3m OR p95 > 400ms for 5m -> rollback to v2.3.0 and run `deploybot set-weight embeddings-service 100% v2.3.0`. Will also pin dedicated pools if needed.
rory: I'm taking eng-lead. +1 on rollback criteria. Confirm infra knobs?
deploybot: Canary checks: health=OK, error_rate=0.4%, tokenizer-smoke=PASS, p95=220ms. Failing checks: none. Manual approvals required: eng-lead, infra.
ana: synthetic checks all green. customer telemetry shows error drop in canary lanes.
leo: infra signoff please @rory. we want staged traffic 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 8m observe.
rory: +1 infra verified autoscaler and nodecapacity. OK to proceed staged.
leo: executing 20% shift now.
deploybot: Command: `deploybot set-weight embeddings-service 20% v2.3.1-hotfix`
deploybot: Shift complete -> 20%. Monitoring 8m window.
ana: watching metrics. currently error-rate stable at 0.2% across total traffic.
leo: observed 5m stable, moving to 60%.
deploybot: Shifting to 60% now.
deploybot: Shift complete -> 60%. Monitoring 8m.
ops-oncall-bot: Temporary alert suppressed for noisy metric 'embeds.spikes' during rollout. Will re-enable after finalization.
ana: 8m window clear. No regressions. ready to finish.
rory: final roll approved. +1 from eng-lead.
leo: rolling to 100% :rocket: 
deploybot: Rolling to 100% -> embeddings-service@v2.3.1-hotfix. Command: `deploybot set-weight embeddings-service 100% v2.3.1-hotfix`
deploybot: Roll complete. Final checks PASS. Service serving v2.3.1-hotfix.
releasebot: Draft release note available: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/embeds-2.3.1-hotfix. Add customer-facing blurb about tokenization safeguard.
leo: tagging sales & cs separately. keeping thread open for 30m watch. thanks all for quick sync. :thumbsup:
